Name: Transmute Iridium Bars
Author: jenf1
Description:
I searched for a mod like this and couldn't find one, so I just quickly threw it together myself.

Allows you to craft Iridium Bars. Learned at Mining level 9, requires 3 Gold Bars.


Install:

- Download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
- Copy [CP] Transmute Iridium Bars into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder
- Load the game using SMAPI and enjoy!

Manifest.Name: Transmute Iridium Bars
Manifest.Description: Allows you to transmute Iridium Bars from Gold Bars.
